parent.rule: Parent segment is immutable in meaning; this file appends events only.

events.event: Completed P0.2 source hardening for priority D/N dependency cards and audited SOGI reporting/representativeness across direct AI-dependence studies and adjacent inclusive AI studies.
major_dependency_updates: D011 NICOTINE: direct therapeutic conversational-agent meta-analytic evidence; general/companion LLM interaction still unproven.
D017 GAMBLING: direct chatbot-CBT RCT evidence exists, but only a very small evidence base and comparative effects are often mixed/null.
D022 PROBLEMATIC_SMARTPHONE_USE: direct cross-sectional association with AI chatbot dependence; causality unresolved.
sogi_major_findings: Core hardened AI-dependence psychometric studies predominantly report binary male/female sex or gender categories.
Male/female measurement invariance does not establish validity for transgender, nonbinary, gender-diverse or orientation-defined groups.
Healthy Minds AI studies directly include LGBQ+ and nonbinary/other-gender variables, but their outcomes are AI companionship/mental-health use rather than dependence or functional impairment.
A dedicated LGBTQ+ social-robot RCT had N=153 with 50.3% TGD representation and demonstrated meaningful condition-by-gender heterogeneity, but it is not an LLM/dependence study.
No hardened direct AI-dependence intersex analysis was located in this pass.
No hardened direct dependence-scale measurement invariance across cisgender versus TGD/nonbinary or heterosexual versus LGBQ+ groups was located in this pass.
source_independence_blocks: Healthy Minds 2024-2025 AI-module papers cannot be counted as independent replication until participant/institution overlap is resolved.
Two smoking chatbot meta-analyses overlap in underlying trial literature and cannot be double-counted.
GAMBOT and GAMBOT2 are separate randomized samples but belong to the same intervention lineage and are not platform-independent replication.
topa_kills: binary sex invariance proves all-gender validity
LGBTQ-targeted AI benefit implies lower AI-dependence risk
lower LGBQ+ companionship use implies lower dependence risk
legacy therapeutic chatbot effects transport to companion/general LLMs
events.claim_ceiling: P0.2 may strengthen source quality, identify reporting gaps and constrain study design. It does not create identity-based risk coefficients or transport intervention effects into ABLI.
events.next_gate: P0.3 study-level SOGI reporting matrix across the 37 Dagnino primary studies plus public-dataset/cell-size and measurement-invariance feasibility audit.

events.event: Bound P0.2 source-hardening and SOGI-representativeness results into CURRENT_AUTHORITY v1.5 and kept ABLI/SOGI identity coefficients frozen.
events.next_gate: Advance to P0.3 without merging main or starting human experiments.
